CapstoneProject.title: Capstone Project - Neurolyzer
CapstoneProject.Summary: This project is a desktop application designed to analyze ABF (Axon Binary File) recordings related to extracellular signals, resonance frequency, and potassium (K⁺) clearance. It provides specialized tools for processing and interpreting neurophysiological data from these experimental modalities.
CapstoneProject.ReleaseInfo: Neurolyzer - Capstone Project, Release is not public. Completed for academic purposes.

E-Paper Keychain.title: E-Paper Keychain
E-Paper Keychain.Summary: Simple e-paper display linked to a esp32-s3-zero with a 3D printed encasement. The goal was to create a small keychain that can display custom messages and images, while being energy efficient thanks to the e-paper technology.
E-Paper Keychain.ReleaseInfo: E-Paper Keychain - Release v1.0.0 on 25/12/2025. Code and 3D files available on my GitHub.
E-Paper Keychain.OtherInfo: E-Paper display, ESP32-S3-Zero, Bambu Lab P1S

BluetoothifiedBarcodeScanner.title: Bluetoothifying a wired Barcode Scanner
BluetoothifiedBarcodeScanner.Summary: I wanna take a salvaged usb-wired barcode scanner and use a esp32 to turn it into a bluetooth version that can connect to phones and tablets.
BluetoothifiedBarcodeScanner.ReleaseInfo: No releases yet, currently in the research and planning phase
BluetoothifiedBarcodeScanner.OtherInfo: Bluetooth low energy, PCB Design, Microcontrollers
